title: Monitor AI quality in production
summary: AI quality can change after launch as users, data and models change. Monitor quality, cost and safety continuously, and act quickly when they slip.

beginner: Pick a few measures: answer quality, user corrections, complaints and cost per use.
Sample real outputs every week and check them by hand.
Re-run your evaluation set whenever the model or prompts change.
Set alerts for sudden changes in quality or cost.
Have a way to roll back to a previous version.
intermediate: Track quality, safety and cost measures.
Review samples and re-run evaluations on change.
Alert on drift and keep rollback ready.
experienced: Feed failures back into the evaluation set.
Report AI quality and cost to leaders like any other product health measure.

toolExamples.claude: Use a grading prompt to score samples of outputs against your criteria, and check a share by hand.
toolExamples.looker: Chart quality and cost per use over time.

definitionOfDone: Quality, safety and cost measures tracked
